strength.note: Parallax scale = texture-space UV offset max. Higher = deeper extrusion

clamping.note: minViewZ = fade out at grazing (vzAbs < min). minEffectiveVz prevents division near-zero. maxOffset caps UV shift to avoid swimming

fading.note: fade = (vzAbs - start)/(end-start) when vzAbs between start/end. Below start = invisible POM

reference.note: POM reference plane centered at 0.5 (height texture mid). Sampled as centered -0.5 offset
